payload.function_structure:
Overall function: pair a phone by a one-click gesture that hands the owner a scannable secret. Sub-functions (verb + noun, no technology):
- Trigger the pairing - offer the gesture on the board [R6].
- Generate the credential - mint an unguessable topic pair [R1].
- Persist the credential - write it to the local config, atomically [R1, R5].
- Encode the credential - turn the topic into a scannable matrix, on our side [R2, R3].
- Present the code - render it where the owner scans [R6].
- Preserve install + boundary - keep one-click install; leave the bless path untouched [R4, R7].
payload.coverage: Every requirement maps to a function: R1 -> Generate + Persist; R2 -> Encode (local); R3 -> Encode (correct); R4 -> Preserve-install; R5 -> Persist (atomic); R6 -> Trigger + Present; R7 -> Preserve-boundary. Every use-case step covered: UC-1 -> Trigger/Generate/Persist/Encode/Present; UC-2 -> Encode-local; UC-3 -> Trigger/Present. No holes.
payload.probes:
Assumptions probed:
- A1 topic-possession authenticity (se.adr-answer-authenticity): PROBED - owner-ruled, accepted; confirmed.
- The QR encoder (vendor vs hand-roll, correctness): NOT yet probed - this IS the M6 spike (a correct local encoder / known-answer). Open, ranked the one unknown.
- ntfy topic generation: a high-entropy random string; trivial; confirmed.
- Board toolbar + details-pane render: the board already has these surfaces (i5c work); wiring only; feasible.
